title: Discounted Pricing at Saltay II | Saltay Hanalei Bay
heading:
A little escape.
A little closer to nature.
description: Discover discounted spa experiences at our second location, nestled beneath the Kalalea mountains on Kaua‘i’s East Side.
location_text: Our Anahola location brings a relaxed, rootsy spirit to your spa experience. Find us in a stand-alone annex hale at the Anahola Marketplace, beneath the Kalalea mountains.
rates_note: All prices are per person at the Saltay II Anahola annex location.
experiences_intro: These spa experiences are available at the Saltay II Anahola annex location.
booking_text: Make time for yourself at Saltay II. Explore availability and book your experience online.
